actions.name: curve (left wheel 30 %, right 0 %): away from a left wall
curve (left wheel 0 %, right 30 %): away from a right wall
curve right (left 40 %, right 10 %) on the floor

control_flow: avoidWalls: if the left light is below 30 %, check the LEFT then RIGHT obstacle sensor and curve away, else call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left, else curve right.

likely_intent.description: While driving through a tunnel, don't hit its walls.

branches.reason: A tunnel's light never falls below 40 %, so the light is never below 30 %: this branch never runs.
branches.outcome: the light is below 30 %: it checks the LEFT and RIGHT obstacle sensors
the light is 30 % or more: it calls driveInTheDark
